title: Marketplace Trust Strategy
background: An online marketplace is losing users because buyers and sellers are concerned about trust and quality.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Identifies platform participants and value exchange
Assesses network effects, trust, and monetization
Evaluates supply and demand growth levers
great_answer_includes: Considers governance, incentives, and quality control
Defines metrics for liquidity and engagement
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear platform strategy structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
